description: Defines a class 'lower_phy_metrics_printer' that implements a metrics notifier for lower physical layer metrics, including methods for handling transmit and receive metrics, printing headers, and printing metrics summaries.

classes.name: lower_phy_metrics_printer
classes.description: Implements a generic lower physical layer metrics printer, inheriting from lower_phy_metrics_notifier, with methods to process and display transmit and receive metrics.

methods.name: on_new_transmit_metrics
methods.description: Handles new transmit metrics, updating statistics and clipping info with thread safety.

methods.name: on_new_receive_metrics
methods.description: Handles new receive metrics, updating statistics and clipping info with thread safety.

methods.name: print_header
methods.description: Prints the header line for metrics display.

methods.name: print_metrics
methods.description: Calculates and prints the current metrics including power levels, PAPR, and clipping probabilities for both TX and RX.
